author: Chris Pereira
description:
I am not enthusiastic about what feels like an inevitable future wherein games and gaming subscription services are inundated with advertisements. That said, I am excited to reinstall Skyrim so I can play an elaborate Ikea ad.

Newly released on Bethesda's Creations site, Kallax Storageborn is a remarkably in-depth Skyrim mod that features the titular Ikea item. But rather than simply adding the Kallax shelving unit as an item you can use to organize your in-game house, the mod turns it into a companion that follows you around, holding an unlimited number of items on your behalf. Oh, and the Kallax is voiced by Matt Berry.

You can get a taste of the mod in the video b
title: A Full-Fledged Skyrim Mod Starring Matt Berry Is Here To Refresh The Game With An Ikea Ad

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Following the big Steam leak that revealed achievement lists and more for upcoming games, Microsoft has officially released the list of Achievements for Gears of War: E-Day, and there is a Shrek/Smash Mouth-inspired one among them.

Players can unlock an achievement called "HEY NOW, YOU'RE AN ALL STAR..." by accumulating 25,000 kills in the Versus multiplay
title: Gears Of War: E-Day Has A Smash Mouth-Inspired Achievement, And That’s Fantastic

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Activision has revealed new information about one of the perks for preordering Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and it's a bit unusual.

People who preorder the game on any platform get the Inner Circuit M4 weapon blueprint, but those who preorder on Xbox will get a translucent OG green version of the gun to celebrate Xbox's 25th anniversary this year. Like the OG translucent Xbox, the weapon blueprint allows players to see through it.

If you preorder MW4 on any other platform, you'll get the same gun, but without the Xbox flourishes. Not only that, but if you're playing on PlayStation or Switch 2, you won't even see the tr
title: We’ve Never Seen Anything Like This In Call Of Duty Before

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
A group of 1,900 employees at Blizzard Entertainment has successfully signed a union contract with Microsoft, securing several guarantees for members. Represented by the Communications Workers of America (CWA), the contract has given the Blizzard workers more workplace flexibility and guaranteed wage increases, but several other industry-first agreements could make this a blueprint for other video game unions to follow.

One of the big wins for the Blizzard union is artificial intelligence guardrails, as the contract stipulates that Microsoft cannot use AI to automate or replace jobs without first talking to the union. Another big win are the job-recall rights for employees, because if they're laid off, Blizzard must offer them an open role within 14 months and inside the union's network before hiring someone from outside. Laid-off union members will also get an additional four weeks of pay--regardless of how long they
title: Blizzard Workers Win Historic Union Contract That Could Set A New Standard For Game Developers

author: Alan Wen
description:
After being officially announced earlier this summer, Persona 6 will now officially also be coming to Nintendo Switch 2. Yet several months later, we still only have the game's spooky green logo to go on and no new information from Sega and Atlus.

The Switch 2 announcement was made towards the end of the September Nintendo Direct, following the reveal that Persona 4 Revival will also be coming to Nintendo Switch 2, albeit for May 20, 2027, several months after the remake releases on other platforms.

But while Persona 4 Revival had a trailer showing how it will run on Switch 2, nothing new was shown for Persona 6. The very brief teaser
title: Persona 6 Got The Smallest Announcement On Nintendo Direct, Despite Big Leak Reveals

author: Jason Fanelli
description:
Last October, I wrote an op-ed for this very website presenting my case for a Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Super Smash Bros. Ultimate. At the time, I thought it was a slam dunk; of the top 10 best-selling games on the original Nintendo Switch, Smash Bros.--which is currently still the third best-selling Switch 1 game ever as of June 30--was the only one to not see any Switch 2-related update, let alone a Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

title: Multiple Switch 2 Editions Were Announced Today, But One Big Exception Remains

description:
Nintendo's new 40th-anniversary Zelda-themed Switch 2 console went on sale on September 8, the same day it was announced, and it sold out immediately.

I bet you can guess what happened next. Listings for the $520 limited-edition console popped up on eBay the same day, with sellers hoping to make tidy profits. There are numerous
title: Switch 2’s 40th-Anniversary Console Sells Out Immediately, And Guess What Happened Next

author: Alan Wen
description:
Capcom's support for Nintendo Switch 2 has been non-stop since day one, and it's only increasing as the publisher has revealed more upcoming releases this fall.

During the September Nintendo Direct, it was revealed that Monster Hunter Wilds and the Resident Evil 2, 3, and 4 remakes will be coming to Nintendo Switch 2.

The Monster Hunter series had enjoyed a period of exclusivity on Nintendo platforms before, while 2021's Monster Hunter Rise had been developed originally as a Nintendo Switch exclusive. This Wilds port is also bringing back a staple feature of the series by allowing up to four hunters play together in local wireless co-
title: Capcom Is Having A Busy Year On Switch 2, With Monster Hunter And Resident Evil Games Coming Very Soon

author: Tomas Franzese
description:
During the September 2026 Nintendo Direct, many new games were announced, and some even shadow-dropped today. The surprise launches ranged from surprising ports of beloved games to Nintendo Switch Online additions and demos for several upcoming Nintendo Switch 2 games. Check out this list to see what you can download on the eShop and play right now.

Crisis Core -Final Fantasy VII- Reunion
title: Every Nintendo Direct Game That You Can Play Right Now

author: Steve Watts
description:
The latest Nintendo Direct showcase ended on a new 3D platformer, but not the new Mario game that was circulating in the rumor mill. Instead it was the next game in the Kirby series, Kirby and the World Beyond, which appears to take a new open-world approach--and then break through that open world to another, bigger open world.

The trailer began unassuming enough, as Kirby explored a lush green world, discovered secrets, and floated behind a waterfall. But then he met a new companion who helped him unlock what can only be described as cosmic-powered versions of his traditional abilities. The example shown was for his classic Sword ability, which has always been modeled after Link from the Legend of Zelda. In this powered-up Sword ability, the sword gained a fiery iridescent glow, and his hat got some
title: Kirby And The World Beyond Announced, Fully Leans Into Kirby As Elder God

author: Steve Watts
description:
Professor Layton has stepped out of the spotlight since its heyday on Nintendo DS and 3DS, but the long wait for another puzzling adventure is finally almost over. A new trailer for Professor Layton and the New World of Steam, aired during the latest Nintendo Direct, revealed a release date, December 10, 2027.

Professor Layton began in 2007, but the last new game in the series launched in 2017. Even that game was a spin-off starring his daughter, though, so New World of Steam will be the first new game starring Layton himself since 2013.

The Layton games were a perfect fit for Nintendo's famed "blue ocean" strategy, tying together a neat Victorian story with brain-tickling puzzles, all presented in a lovely animated art style. The games are very good--and there isn
title: After 9 Years, We’re Finally Getting More Of The Excellent Professor Layton

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
When Rockstar released GTA 6's first trailer in December 2023, the game looked like it was coming along well, but it wasn't "fully formed" back then. That's according to Rockstar North boss Rob Nelson, who said in an interview that the trailer's song, Tom Petty's "Love is a Long Road" was a "mission statement" for the developers to rally around to get the game finished.

"With the first trailer for this game, the Tom Petty song was a real sort of mission statement. You don’t have the game fully formed, you have an idea of what it’s going to be, but you really have to push hard to pull that together and so when this team is able to do that--and it’s definitely made with everything that you’ve got, but it’s the best of everything you’ve got at that point--it’s put together in such a way that it helps be a bit of a guiding light of what it needs to feel like," he told
title: GTA 6 Was Not “Fully Formed” When Trailer 1 Came Out In 2023

author: Jessica Cogswell
description:
Whether you love it or hate it, or simply wish it had a better name, friendslop is taking the world by storm. 2026 has introduced a plethora of new titles to the emerging genre, but perhaps none have had the same level of overnight success as Meccha Chameleon, a hide-and-seek style multiplayer game that puts player creativity to the test. After taking over Steam with 10 million copies sold in just about two weeks, Meccha Chameleon is making the jump to consoles, as Nintendo just announced it is coming to Switch 2 today.

As revealed during
title: 2026’s Best Friendslop Game Is Coming To Switch 2 Today

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
As part of the Nintendo Direct today, Nintendo announced a free update for Mario Kart World that adds courses from the original Mario Kart game, 1992's Super Mario Kart. People don't have to wait--the update is out today.

Classic courses from that game, including Choco Island, Vanilla Lake, and Ghost Valley, will be available to play in Versus. There are 10 courses in total.

Additionally, players can ride over question-mark panels to grab item
title: Mario Kart World Free Update Is Out Today With All This New Stuff

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Square Enix has announced a remake of the 1995 RPG classic, Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United, during the September Nintendo Direct. Billed as a "full 3D remake" by the company, this new version of Romancing SaGa 3 will feature upgraded graphics, fully voiced cutscenes, overhauls to combat and other mechanics, selectable difficulty levels, and several more new features.

Set in a world with scheduled despair, the game follows eight protagonists on their quest to find the survivor of a calamity. Each protagonist has their own reason for doing so, but the driving force behind their actions is the Rise of Morastrum, an event that occurs every 300 years and results in all newborn life being destroyed, save for one survivor, the Child of Destiny.

Like the original game, players will hav
title: Romancing SaGa 3 Is The Latest Surprise RPG Remake

author: Evan Campbell
description:
Onyx: The Dark Grip was a surprise announcement at today's Nintendo Direct, especially considering it's playable only in handheld mode. A Switch 2 exclusive, the 2.5D horror title comes from Bloober Team, the developer behind the Silent Hill 2 remake and Chronos: The New Dawn.

The portable-only title will see players becoming "the mysterious Entity," using touch-screen controls to "manipulate reality," according to the YouTube trailer. The protagonist's name is Holden, and he enters a desolate, fog-filled town where things aren't normal (surprise, surprise). Along with the touch screen, motion controls are also ut
title: A New Handheld-Only Switch 2 Game Is Coming From The Silent Hill 2 Remake Devs

author: Jason Fanelli
description:
Today, during the Nintendo Direct livestream, Nintendo announced Metroid Ravenous, a new 2D adventure coming exclusively to Nintendo Switch 2 early next year.

The debut trailer introduced a new group of mysterious villains, as well as a look at some of the new locales Samus will be traveling through to hunt then down. We also see hints of a a new mechanic where Samus "feeds" on enemies to gain extra powers, though exactly how Samus is augmented by feeding is still a mystery.

We also see a new suit, with green armor and a glowing energy sw
title: Samus Is Returning To 2D In Metroid Ravenous, And She Talks Again

author: Chris Compendio
description:
The black sheep of the Star Fox series, Star Fox Adventures, has landed on the Nintendo Switch Online service. As announced in the September 2026 Nintendo Direct, the GameCube title is available to play as a Nintendo Classic today for subscribers of Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack.

Star Fox Adventures came out in 2002 and marked a departure from the dog-fighting gameplay the series is known for. Developed by Rare, the game began life as Dinosaur Planet for Nintendo 64 before Shigeru Miyamoto proposed converting it into a Star Fox game.

Featuring Zelda-like action-adventure gameplay, Adventures has Fox McCloud stepping out of the Arwing and
title: Now You Can Play Star Fox Adventures On Switch 2 And Decide If It’s Terrible Or Great Yourself

author: Callum Self
description:
There’s nothing like a good slasher around the best time of the year. I’m talking about the Halloween festivities, of course, and the Halloween game comes at a perfect time, bringing the 1v4 asymmetrical experience found in Dead by Daylight or the gone-but-not-forgotten Friday the 13th to the residents of Haddonfield. If you want to get a screaming good deal, the new Halloween adaptation already has a discount worthy of the slasher icon at launch.

It’s hard to describe what makes asymmetrical experiences like this some of the best horror games, but I’ll take a stab at it. Whereas most horror games—which I adore as a genre, may I add—have predetermined situations, when the monster chasing you is another player, all bets are off. That makes every scare feel distinct, and as the fear of seeing the same scares wears off, games like Halloween thrive on randomn
title: Halloween Game Gets Price Slashed In This Launch Day Discount

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
It's the big day for Nintendo fans, as the annual September Direct kicks off in a few minutes. Running for roughly 45 minutes, this broadcast is expected to offer a fresh look at everything coming to Switch consoles from Nintendo and its third-party partners. The June 2026 Nintendo Direct featured a ton of trailers for a wide range of games, so we're expecting more of the same today--and maybe even a few surprises. As always, we'll be covering the Direct live, so you can keep scrolling down for fresh updates and trailers.

According to the rumor mill, Nintendo might be looking to drop a few first looks during this presentation, with reports claiming that we could get our first look at new Star Fox and 3D Mario games. While you'll have to tune in to see if any of tho
title: Nintendo Direct September 2026: All The Biggest Announcements And Games

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Anthropic alignment science lead Evan Hubinger has said the AI company behind Claude and other AI products "earnestly" believes that AI "could kill all humans," and it could happen in the next decade.

Posting in response to Anthropic AI researcher Jacob Coxon's own resignation from the company due to safety concerns, Hubinger said, "We really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans! I personally think it is >10% within the next decade."

He added: "I believe Anthropic is trying its best, but we do not yet have a plan to solve alignment for superintelligence and are not clearly on track to.
title: AI Could “Kill All Humans” In Next Decade, Anthropic Lead Says

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: Today is not a good day to be hit with Kingdom Hearts 4 spoilers, as thanks to what appears to be a massive Steam leak, achievement lists for multiple games have appeared online. Amongst the games caught in the leak is Kingdom Hearts 4, and if the data is real, several of the game's worlds have been revealed early. So far, only the world of Pixar's Coco has been officially confirmed by Disney, but it looks like players might be visiting one of the biggest IP from the House of Mouse, for the first time ever. Consider yourselves warned, as there are potential spoilers below.
title: Kingdom Hearts 4 Leak Reveals One Of Its Most Unexpected Worlds

author: Eddie Makuch
description: One of the talking points surrounding the upcoming Resident Evil movie is that director Zach Cregger took an original idea and slapped the Resident Evil name on it. That's not true, Cregger has said, and now he's shared more of his thought process as it relates to some of the blowback from fans of the games.
title: Resident Evil Movie Director Reacts To Backlash, Says He Was “Naive” To Think Gamers Would Embrace Him

author: Callum Self
description:
RoboCop: Rogue City might be one of the best modern translations of an ’80s movie into a videogame. That’s an odd niche to be in, sure, but it’s one of the best FPS games for its absolutely brutal action mixed with a faithful RoboCop experience that doesn’t pull any punches. At just over $1 / £1, it’s an absolute bargain, so now’s your time to play it.

Featuring an original storyline set between the events of RoboCop 2 and RoboCop 3—technically making it based on the ’90s version, but don’t stop me now—you play as the titular RoboCop, who used to be Alex Murphy. During a mission, RoboCop starts seeing visions of his past life, including seeing a hostage as his old wife. He hesitates, and obviously, for the fellows at OCP, that’s not good.

With a f
title: RoboCop: Rogue City Is An Underappreciated FPS That’s Just Over A Dollar Right Now

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
A massive Steam leak has revealed hundreds of achievements for upcoming games, including highly anticipated titles like Kingdom Hearts 4, Persona 6, and Fable. On the website Exophase--which tracks achievements for games on Steam, Epic Games Store, and more--the achievement lists for numerous in-development games were uploaded to it and made public. It looks like the site trackers scraped up all the achievements uploaded to Steam recently, resulting in potential story spoilers and the reveal of several unannounced--or canceled--titles.

title: Major Steam Leak Reveals Achievements For Persona 6, Kingdom Hearts 4, And Unannounced Games

Yesterday's broadcast was mostly focused on the upcoming remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, but today, we're expecting to see a whole lot more than just the hero in green. In case you can't make it, we'll be covering each new announcement and trailer as they drop, so keep on scrolling to see all the reveals and hit
title: Nintendo Direct September 2026: Start Time, How To Watch, And What To Expect
